author: NoemiG194

title: Perfect private tour by Rosa
text:
My wife and I visited Barcelona with 2 friends and booked a small group tour on Friday 20th of June. When we arrived our guide Rosa was already there and we were informed we were only with the 4 of us: a private tour! We started the tour outside and visited La Pedrera in about 2.5 hrs. Rosa is a great guide to show you all the important spots and as she is from Barcelona she answers all our questions about Gaudi and Barcelona easiy. At the end she showed us some buildings nearby Casa Millo and she gave us great restaurant tips. 

Highly recommended!
author: CarloRens

title: Martha's knowledge and personality made Gaudi and Barcelona memorable.
text: Marth Pi brought the Gaudi style and decor to life with her stories and attention to detail.  Her guidance, knowledge and personality make Barcelona memorable and invite us to return. Thank you, Martha. Phil Samuels and Claudia Dunning, Medford, OR. April 2025.
author: Philip_S

title: Laura gave a great tour!
text: Laura was a very thorough and enthusiastic guide. We truly enjoyed the tour and appreciated her kindness and humor.
author: Jennifer_B

title: Agnes was great - very...
text: Agnes was great - very informative and helpful. We enjoyed walking about the interior and rooftop (between raindrops) of La Pedrera. Agnes took good care of us as we made our way down to Casa Batllo, too.
author: David

title: Perfect guided tour experience!  Small group!!
text: Perfect tour of both of Gaudi locations - perfect amount of time and overview in both.  Tour guide got us special treatment in the elevators also and was very informative of the locations.
